references.text: Moses goes up the mountain to receive the stone tablets with God's commandments
Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights
God gave Moses the two tablets of testimony, stone tablets written by the finger of God
Moses was with the Lord for forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water
Reference to the covenant that the Lord made with Israel
Moses repeats that he fell down before the face of the Lord for forty days and forty nights without food or water
Elijah went in the strength of the food for forty days and forty nights to God's mountain Horeb
Jesus fasted for forty days and forty nights in the wilderness
